## Activity

During June 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 113 captures. This represents the completed activity reported for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the image quality and grading results below when reviewing site operations and identifying any areas requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 113 captures, 4 were ungradable. This gives an ungradable rate of 3.5%. The result is recorded for routine monitoring of image quality. Any recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead, to support appropriate follow-up and reduce avoidable image-quality problems.

## Grading

There were 20 referable results. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, these results provide the monthly summary of grading activity for Hill Counties Health Centre. The grading outcome and the ungradable rate should be reviewed with the activity total to support ongoing oversight of the service and timely identification of operational issues.
